svg.title: Materialized View
svg.desc: Materialized View. Precompute query-shaped views so reads don't pay for joins and aggregations. Step 1, Same query, every time: Every dashboard view re-runs the same join and aggregation on the source tables: slow, every time. Step 2, Precompute the answer: A materialized view stores the answer, one row per product; the dashboard just reads rows in 5 ms. Step 3, Keep it fresh: A new order makes the view stale until a scheduled full refresh or an incremental update catches up. Step 4, Rebuild it, know the price: For a new question, build a second view beside the first, switch readers, then drop the old one.
